title_en: Farewell, Sgt. Russell Uma has died after being shot in the face.
summary_en: On October 16, 2569, an unknown number of assailants using guns of unspecified size and type sniped a member of the Volunteer Land Guard Corps from Mai Kaen Township in Pattani Province while he was travelling by motorcycle to pray at the area of Village No. 2.
